Welcome to Valhally Casino, where every visit brings something new to explore. Follow your favourites, try something different or take your seat at a live table. We've brought casino games and sports betting together in one place, so you can enjoy them all with a single account.

There's always another adventure waiting, whether you're chasing a jackpot, discovering a new slot or taking part in one of our tournaments. Make Valhally your own, build your VIP status and enjoy the rewards that come with every new milestone.

Game Categories and Live Lobbies Inspired by the Gods of Asgard

We have organised our games into separate categories, so you can choose between popular slots, new releases, bonus feature games and live tables. Our providers include Playson, BGaming, Hacksaw, Yggdrasil, Spinomenal, Betsoft and many other studios. Alongside regular slots, you can explore Jackpots, Buy Bonus, Crash Games, Instant Games and table games.

Top Slots, New Releases and Popular Games at Valhally

Our Top category brings together standout titles with different features. Golden Joker 100 Hold And Win offers the familiar Hold and Win mechanic, while Luck of Panda: Bonus Combo features an Asian-inspired theme and bonus rounds. You can also find Blast the Bass, Fruit Million and Snoop Dogg Dollars in this section.

The New category is regularly updated with fresh releases, including Cash Balloon, Charge Bison Ascent and Frog Dash 10000. In Popular, you can return to Wanted Dead or a Wild, Fortune Tiger or Mahjong Ways 2. We have also created Beards and Gold, a dedicated collection featuring slots such as Asgardian Rising, Halls of Odin and Viking Gold. These games bring together Vikings, Norse gods and mythological themes.

Buy Bonus contains games where you can purchase access to a bonus feature for a set amount. Titles in this category include 3 Hot Chillies, Diamond of Jungle and Wild Buffalo: Fortune Wheel Bonus Buy. Purchasing a bonus round does not guarantee a win, and its cost is displayed within the game. Many slots also offer a demo mode, allowing you to explore their features without using your real-money balance.

Bonus Friendly Slots for Meeting Wagering Requirements

Our Bonus Friendly category helps you find games that can be played with active bonuses. It includes Snoop Dogg Dollars, Fortune Garuda 500, Coin Reel: Hold to Win, The Great Icescape and other slots. However, how much each bet contributes towards wagering depends on the game's features and the terms of your active promotion.

Under our general bonus rules, different game categories contribute towards wagering requirements as follows:

Game Category Wagering Contribution
Slots without bonus features 100%
Slots with bonus features 50%
Roulette and blackjack 10%
Crash Games 5%

The maximum bet with an active bonus is €5 per round under our general rules. Certain games do not contribute towards wagering, while individual promotions may have additional restrictions. You can find the full terms for welcome packages, free spins and other rewards on our Valhally Casino bonus page.

Live Games with Real Dealers

Our Live Casino features more than 500 live dealer games. Choose from classic card games, roulette tables and formats with special features. Available titles include Speed Blackjack, Grand Bonus Baccarat, Venice Roulette and Monaco Blackjack 5. Different table variations have their own rules, dealing speeds and betting limits.

Alongside traditional blackjack and roulette, our live lobbies include baccarat and other table games. We also offer special versions with additional multipliers that can change the outcome of individual rounds. Each table has its own minimum and maximum betting limits.

Roulette and Blackjack with Faster Gameplay

Our Roulette category includes classic variations and games with alternative payout features. For example, Roulette Multiplier Spin introduces multipliers that can affect the returns on selected bets. Other options include Lucky Roulette and Venice Roulette.

Blackjack includes conventional tables and faster formats such as Speed Blackjack. In these versions, shorter intervals between hands create a quicker pace of play. Monaco Blackjack 5 offers another live blackjack option. The specific rules, number of decks and betting limits are displayed for each table.

Game Shows with Interactive Live Entertainment

Game Shows offer something different from traditional table games. Instead of standard card hands or roulette spins, these formats feature prize wheels, random multipliers and bonus rounds. Some shows are hosted by live presenters, while special features can change the potential payout during a single round.

Each show's rules determine which sectors or outcomes are available for betting and how multipliers apply. Game Shows form a separate Live Casino category, so standard roulette or blackjack rules do not automatically apply to these formats.

Valhally Casino Bonuses and Promotions

We have prepared three welcome packages with different eligibility requirements. The Casino Welcome Pack covers your first five deposits and includes 450 free spins for Gold Rush with Johnny Cash. The VIP Welcome Pack applies to your first three deposits, while the Crypto Welcome Pack provides rewards for cryptocurrency deposits.

Welcome Package Maximum Offer Number of Deposits
Casino Welcome Pack 450% up to €28,000 + 450 FS 5
VIP Welcome Pack 500% up to €28,000 3
Crypto Welcome Pack 500% up to 17,000 USDT + 500 FS 5

The Crypto Welcome Pack requires a minimum deposit of 28 USDT, with 500 free spins awarded for Bonanza Trillion. Bonuses are activated through qualifying deposits. Only one deposit bonus can be active at a time.

Once you have completed your Welcome Pack, Weekly Reloads become available, with eight offers throughout the week. These include deposit bonuses ranging from 30% to 100%, with maximum amounts between €200 and €700. The minimum deposit is €20 for most offers and €50 for selected promotions. Two different offers are available on Fridays, including one with exclusive terms.

Alongside deposit bonuses, we run tournaments, offer rewards through the Wheel of Gods and provide additional benefits through our VIP Club. Each programme has its own reward structure.

Wheel of Gods - Rewards from Zeus and Hades

Wheel of Gods consists of two wheels, each with eight sectors. Zeus Wheel provides one free spin every 24 hours after your first successful deposit. Once you have used your free spin, Hades Wheel becomes available, allowing you to purchase an additional spin using your real-money balance.

We have divided the feature into two options:

  • Zeus Wheel - one free spin during each 24-hour cycle. Unused spins do not accumulate.
  • Hades Wheel - one paid spin after using Zeus Wheel. The cost is displayed before you spin and is deducted regardless of the outcome.
  • Rewards - bonus funds ranging from €1 to €435 or between 5 and 100 free spins, depending on the result.
  • Wagering - x35 applies to bonus rewards. The maximum amount of bonus funds that can be converted into real money is limited to five times the bonus amount.

Both wheels operate within the same cycle, and outcomes are determined randomly. Wheel of Gods is separate from our deposit promotions and has its own reward conditions.

Jackpots and Tournaments with Cash Prizes

Valhally offers a Jackpot prize pool of up to €1,000,000. We provide two jackpot types. Fixed jackpots have a predetermined prize amount, while progressive jackpots grow through qualifying bets and begin accumulating again after a win. Individual games may feature several jackpot tiers. Participation requires real-money bets.

Jackpot slots also have their own category, featuring games such as Jackpot Raiders, 777 Jackpot Diamond Hold and Win and Frost Queen Jackpots. The requirements for triggering a jackpot and its potential value may vary between games.

We also run two major campaigns featuring slots from Playson and Booongo:

  • Lucky Boom - a total prize pool of €600,000, with €30,000 allocated to each stage. To qualify, you need to complete at least 100 spins at €0.50 or more on participating games. Every qualifying spin has a chance to trigger a random cash prize, and multiple rewards can be won during the promotion.
  • Big Sunday Blast - a weekly Sunday tournament with a €25,000 prize pool. Entry requires at least 100 spins with a minimum stake of €0.50. Rankings are determined by the highest win multiplier achieved in a single round. Prizes are awarded to 150 players, with €3,500 for first place.

Lucky Boom and Big Sunday Blast use different reward mechanics. Lucky Boom distributes random cash prizes through qualifying spins, while Big Sunday Blast ranks players according to their highest single-round multiplier. You do not need the highest total winnings across all rounds to top the Big Sunday Blast leaderboard.

VIP Club - 17 Levels from Bronze to Obsidian

Our VIP Club features 17 levels across five status groups: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum and Obsidian. The first four groups each contain four levels, while Obsidian is the highest status. Progression requires you to meet the necessary Gems, Stars and cumulative deposit thresholds. Once all requirements are met, you can activate your next status through Level Up in your account.

At Bronze 1, daily cashback starts at 3%. It increases as you progress, reaching 40% at Obsidian. The maximum cashback amount also rises with your status, from €500 to €10,000. Daily rakeback is available separately and can reach 60% at the highest level. These are two different rewards with their own calculation rules.

Level progression unlocks Level-Up Rewards, including bonus funds and free spins. At Obsidian, the level-up reward is €5,000 plus 200 FS. Other benefits include a personal VIP manager, additional promotions, gifts, priority support and exclusive tournaments. Availability depends on your current status.

Your VIP level also affects withdrawal limits, which can range from €7,000 to €30,000 depending on your status. You must complete KYC verification to join the programme. Once achieved, your VIP level is retained even during extended periods of inactivity.

Sports Betting and Esports

Our Sportsbook covers dozens of sports, including football, basketball, tennis and ice hockey. You can place bets before matches begin or use Live betting during events. Our dedicated esports section also covers Counter-Strike, Dota 2 and other competitive games.

For football, we offer Early Payout. This feature allows an eligible pre-match 1X2 bet to be settled as a win before full-time if your selected team takes a two-goal lead. For example, if you back the home team and they go 2-0 ahead, your eligible bet is settled as a winner regardless of the final score.

Early Payout only applies to matches carrying the relevant tag. Home and away win selections qualify, while draw bets are excluded. The feature is available for selected football competitions and does not automatically apply to every sporting event.

Your Account and Payments

Once registered, you can access your balance, active bonuses, betting history and account settings. To return to your account, use the email address and password created during registration. If you experience difficulties signing in, resetting your password or accessing your profile, you can find the relevant information on our Valhally Casino login page.

We support bank cards, e-wallets, bank transfers and cryptocurrencies. Available payment options include Visa, Mastercard, Skrill, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Bitcoin, Ethereum and Tether. The minimum deposit starts from €10, while the minimum withdrawal amount is €50.

Standard withdrawal limits are €500 per day, €2,000 per week and €7,000 per month. Higher limits may apply according to your VIP status. KYC verification must be completed before a withdrawal, and standard processing can take up to three banking days. The time required for funds to arrive afterwards depends on the payment method. Details of withdrawal limits, documentation and payment options are available in our withdrawal information.

We use identity verification and financial monitoring to help protect accounts and transactions. Full KYC verification is required before withdrawals and in other circumstances covered by our rules. You can also request betting limits or Self Exclusion through our support team.

Valhally Casino is intended for players aged 18 and over in regions where gambling is permitted. We support responsible gambling, including options to limit your activity or temporarily restrict access to your account.

Our Valhally Bonus offers are designed for different ways to play. Pick a welcome package that suits you, explore fresh promotions throughout the week and unlock more benefits as your VIP status grows. Every offer comes with its own terms, so you can see exactly what's available before taking part.

Valhally Casino Welcome Bonuses

We have prepared three welcome packages for new players, each with different rewards and activation methods. The Casino Welcome Pack covers five deposits, the VIP Welcome Pack applies to three deposits, and the Crypto Welcome Pack is designed for cryptocurrency payments.

Casino Welcome Pack - 450% Up to €28,000 and 450 FS

The Casino Welcome Pack includes a total bonus of 450% up to €28,000 and 450 free spins for Gold Rush with Johnny Cash by BGaming. The package applies to your first five deposits. The maximum bonus amount and number of free spins apply to the entire package, not to each individual deposit.

To activate the Casino Welcome Pack:

  1. Once registered, open the cashier.
  2. Select Casino Welcome Pack from the available bonuses.
  3. Make a deposit that meets the requirements of your current bonus stage.
  4. Receive the bonus funds and free spins allocated to that deposit.

No promo code is required. The wagering requirement is x40 on the combined value of your deposit and bonus. You have 7 days to meet this requirement, and the maximum winnings from bonus funds are limited to ten times the bonus amount. Winnings from free spins have a separate conversion limit of up to twice the winnings, capped at €1,000.

VIP Welcome Pack - 500% Up to €28,000

The VIP Welcome Pack offers up to 500% in bonus funds, with a combined maximum of €28,000 across your first three deposits. Compared with the Casino Welcome Pack, this offer has a higher maximum bonus percentage and requires larger qualifying deposits.

To activate the offer, select VIP Welcome Pack in the cashier before making your deposit. The package carries an x40 wagering requirement on the deposit and bonus combined, with 7 days to complete it. The maximum convertible winnings are limited to ten times the bonus amount. You cannot use the VIP Welcome Pack alongside another active deposit bonus.

Crypto Welcome Pack - 500% Up to 17,000 USDT and 500 FS

The Crypto Welcome Pack covers your first five cryptocurrency deposits and includes 500% up to 17,000 USDT plus 500 free spins for Bonanza Trillion by BGaming. The minimum qualifying deposit is 28 USDT. Select the Crypto Welcome Pack in the cashier and fund your account using an eligible cryptocurrency to activate the offer.

This package has an x40 wagering requirement on the combined deposit and bonus amount, with 7 days to complete it. Maximum winnings from bonus funds are capped at ten times the bonus amount. Free spin winnings have separate limits: up to twice the winnings, with a maximum of €1,000.

Weekly Reloads - Eight Bonuses Every Week

Once you have completed your Welcome Pack, we unlock Weekly Reloads. Eight deposit offers are available throughout the week, with bonuses ranging from 30% to 100%. The largest Reload offers 100% up to €700, while the lowest wagering requirement in the programme is x20.

Day Bonus Minimum Deposit Wagering

After completing your welcome package, open the cashier and select the available Weekly Reloads offer before topping up your balance.

Jackpots and Special Prize Pools

Alongside deposit bonuses, we have a Jackpot prize pool worth up to €1,000,000. Fixed jackpots offer a set prize amount, while progressive jackpots grow through qualifying bets. Participation requires real-money stakes. At our casino, jackpot games have their own category, including Jackpot Raiders, 777 Jackpot Diamond Hold and Win and Frost Queen Jackpots.

Regular Tournaments and Special Promotions

We run two campaigns featuring games from Playson and Booongo, each with a different way of awarding prizes. Big Sunday Blast uses a leaderboard based on win multipliers, while Lucky Boom distributes random cash prizes through qualifying spins.

Big Sunday Blast - €25,000 Sunday Tournament

Big Sunday Blast has a €25,000 prize pool every Sunday. To qualify, you need to complete at least 100 spins with a minimum stake of €0.50 on participating Playson or Booongo slots. The leaderboard is based on the highest win multiplier achieved in a single round, rather than the total amount staked or won.

Prizes are awarded to 150 players. First place receives €3,500, while players ranked 126-150 receive €50 each. Rewards are credited automatically or after the tournament ends. Qualifying rounds count towards the competition according to the promotion rules, while Free Spins rounds are excluded from tournament results.

Lucky Boom - Random Cash Prizes

Lucky Boom has a total prize pool of €600,000, divided into individual stages worth €30,000 each. To take part, you must complete at least 100 spins with a minimum stake of €0.50 on selected Playson and Booongo games.

Every qualifying spin has a chance to trigger a random cash prize from the current stage's prize pool. You can receive multiple rewards during the same promotion period while prizes remain available. Unlike Big Sunday Blast, Lucky Boom does not use a highest-multiplier leaderboard. Unclaimed rewards expire 90 days after being awarded.

Wheel of Gods - Rewards from Zeus and Hades

Wheel of Gods features two eight-sector wheels offering bonus funds and free spins. Access becomes available after your first successful deposit. Zeus Wheel provides one free spin every 24 hours, after which you can purchase a spin on Hades Wheel.

The following rules apply to Wheel of Gods:

  • Zeus Wheel - one free spin every 24 hours. Unused spins do not accumulate.
  • Hades Wheel - one paid spin after the free spin. The cost is deducted from your real-money balance and is non-refundable.
  • Rewards - bonus funds from €1 to €435 or between 5 and 100 FS.
  • Wagering - x35 applies to bonus rewards. The maximum amount of bonus funds that can be converted into real money is limited to five times the bonus amount.

Both wheels operate within the same 24-hour cycle. Each spin has a random outcome, and another deposit is not required to access your next free spin.

VIP Programme and Level-Up Bonuses

Our VIP Club has 17 levels, ranging from Bronze to Obsidian. To reach the next status, you need to meet the cumulative deposit, Gems and Stars requirements, then activate Level Up in your account.

As you move up the levels, you can receive Level-Up Rewards consisting of bonus funds and free spins. At the highest Obsidian status, the reward is €5,000 and 200 FS. Wagering requirements for level-up rewards vary by status, from x40 at the lower levels to x10 at Obsidian.

The VIP Club also includes daily cashback ranging from 3% to 40% and rakeback of up to 60%. These rewards are calculated separately, and the amounts available depend on your current status. You must complete KYC verification to participate in the programme. Once achieved, your VIP level does not decrease due to inactivity.

Bonus Friendly Games and Wagering Rules

Our Bonus Friendly category includes slots that can be played with active bonuses, such as Snoop Dogg Dollars, Diamond of Jungle, Fortune Garuda 500 and Coin Reel: Hold to Win. Bets on these games may contribute differently towards wagering, so appearing in the Bonus Friendly category does not automatically mean that every spin counts at 100%.

x40 Wagering, Maximum Bets and Game Contributions

Our welcome deposit packages have an x40 wagering requirement on the combined deposit and bonus amount (D+B). For example, if you deposit €100 and receive a €100 bonus, the total required wagering turnover is €8,000. This is not the amount you need to lose, but the total value of qualifying bets required to meet the wagering condition.

Not every bet contributes in full. Under our general bonus rules, game categories have different wagering contributions:

Game Category Wagering Contribution
Slots without bonus features 100%
Slots with bonus features 50%
Roulette and blackjack 10%
Crash and Casual Games 5%
Games excluded from bonus wagering 0%

If a slot has a 50% wagering contribution, a €4 bet adds €2 towards the requirement. At a 10% contribution, the same bet counts as €0.40. The maximum permitted stake while playing with an active bonus is €5 per round.

Some slots do not contribute towards wagering, even if they are available in the main games collection. Buy Bonus and other special features may also carry additional restrictions. Only eligible bets placed on qualifying games count towards your wagering progress.

Bonus Rules, Cancellation and Account Verification

Bonus funds are held separately from your real-money balance. Only one deposit bonus can be active at a time. If wagering requirements are not completed within the permitted period or the maximum bet limit is breached, the bonus and associated winnings may be forfeited.

Welcome bonuses have a maximum winnings limit of x10 the bonus amount. Rewards from Wheel of Gods, VIP Club and other promotions may carry different limits.

Once wagering requirements have been met, eligible bonus winnings can be transferred to your withdrawable balance. Identity verification must also be completed before withdrawing funds. Financial limits and verification procedures are explained in our withdrawal terms. If you have trouble signing in or accessing your bonus balance, you can restore access through your account login.

We support responsible gambling and offer Self Exclusion options. Bonuses and tournament rewards do not guarantee winnings, and promotions are available only to eligible players aged 18 and over.

pages.content:
Log in to CaratLuck Casino and pick up where you left off with your existing balance, favourite slots and active rewards. Your account keeps your personal settings and transaction history, so everything you need remains available whenever you sign in.

To log in to CaratLuck, enter the email address and password you used when registering. We protect your personal information, monitor suspicious activity and help you regain access if you encounter any difficulties.

How to Log In and Complete Verification

Signing in to your CaratLuck account takes just a few simple steps. Click the Login button in the top menu, enter your account details and return to your personal dashboard. There, you can check your balance, transaction history, active bonuses and profile settings.

To access your account, follow these steps:

  1. Click the Login button at the top of the page.

  2. Enter the email address you used during registration.

  3. Enter your account password.

  4. Click Login to complete the sign-in process.

Logging in and verifying your identity are two separate processes. Your email address and password are sufficient for a standard login, while Know Your Customer (KYC) checks help us confirm that the account belongs to you. Additional verification may be required before certain financial transactions, even if you've previously accessed your account without any issues.

Full KYC verification is mandatory when you request a withdrawal, when your cumulative deposits exceed €2,000 or if we detect suspicious activity. Depending on your payment method, country of residence and the nature of your transactions, we may request documents earlier, regardless of how much you've deposited.

To verify your identity, we may ask for:

  • A valid passport, national identity card or driving licence.

  • A selfie holding your identification document.

  • A bank statement, utility bill or other proof of address issued within the last three months.

  • Additional documents relating to your payment method or source of funds if required for verification.

For deposits exceeding €5,000, we apply Source of Wealth checks. These involve confirming the legitimate origin of your funds through documents relating to employment income, business earnings, investments or other sources of income. Additional checks may also apply to cryptocurrency transactions under our AML Policy.

During verification, we use different levels of checks, including SDD, CDD and EDD, depending on our risk assessment. If the documents provided are insufficient or the information doesn't match your account details, we may request further evidence. Certain financial features may remain restricted until the required checks are complete. Once verification is successful, we'll confirm your account's verification status.

Security Standards and Account Monitoring

We protect your account every time you log in to CaratLuck Casino through technical and organisational security measures. We monitor financial transactions and unusual activity to help prevent unauthorised access and fraud.

Suspicious login attempts, unusual transactions or inconsistencies in personal information may trigger additional security checks. In such cases, we may temporarily restrict access to certain features until we've verified the account holder's identity. If documents are required, our team will explain what information you need to provide.

To protect financial transactions, we check that payment methods match the account holder's details. Bank cards, e-wallets and other payment methods must belong to the person registered on the account. Under our AML Policy, withdrawals must be made using the same payment method used for the initial deposit.

We use your personal information to manage your account, verify your identity, process transactions and meet applicable requirements. We do not sell personal information to third parties. However, certain details may be shared with payment partners, authorised service providers or relevant authorities where permitted or required by our policies.

Use a unique password and never share it with anyone else. If you sign in on a shared device or someone else's computer, make sure you log out when you've finished. Avoid saving passwords in publicly accessible browsers, and never disclose confidential account information to other people.

If you notice unfamiliar transactions, changes to your settings or activity you don't recognise, contact our support team. We'll investigate the circumstances and, if necessary, request identity verification or temporarily restrict access to protect your information and funds.

We allow each player to create only one personal account. Creating duplicate accounts, sharing access with other people or using someone else's identification documents breaches our rules and may result in additional verification, restricted account features or account suspension.
<p>Once access has been restored, you can log in to CaratLuck Casino, check your balance and view your active rewards. Any unused <a href="/promotions/">welcome offers and bonuses</a> remain available only within the specified promotional periods and conditions. We take care of your account security and support responsible gambling for players aged 18 and over.</p>

mainEntity.name: Can I Get Free Spins Without Making a Deposit?

acceptedAnswer.text: We offer 10 free spins for verifying your email address. Winnings from this promotion are subject to a maximum withdrawal amount of €50.

mainEntity.name: Can I Use Bonus Funds to Buy Bonus Features?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can purchase bonus features depends on the restrictions of your active promotion. A slot appearing in the Buy Bonus category does not automatically mean that purchasing its bonus feature is permitted while wagering a deposit bonus.

mainEntity.name: Can I Receive Cashback and Rakeback at the Same Time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both reward types are available through our VIP Club. They are calculated separately, and the applicable percentages and maximum amounts depend on your current VIP level.

mainEntity.name: Does Valhally Casino Have a Mobile App?

acceptedAnswer.text: We support mobile browser play alongside app options for Android and iOS. Installation availability depends on your device and the relevant app version.

mainEntity.name: Can KYC Verification Be Required Before My First Withdrawal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Full identity verification may be required when your total deposits exceed €2,000 or when financial activity requires additional checks. You may need to provide photographic identification, a selfie and proof of address.

mainEntity.name: Can I Temporarily Block My Own Account?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can request temporary or permanent Self Exclusion. During the selected period, access to games and account transactions is restricted. Contact our support team to arrange this.
